name: RoboCult
source:
You feel dizzy.. where are you?  
Most importantly.. who are you?  
With a hazy mind you find your saviour at last. 
You do not have to worry anymore, that isn't your task.
Will you follow the light or the darkness?

[From [url=https://biinxiix.itch.io/robocult]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你感到头晕..你在哪里？
最重要的是..你是谁？
带着朦胧的头脑，你终于找到了你的救世主。
你不必再担心了，那不是你的任务。
你会追随光明还是黑暗？

[来自[url=https://biinxiix.itch.io/robocult]itch.io[/url]]
